description: §41.13 a repeated key — the string input '{"tag":"Success","rows":42,"rows":7}' names `rows` twice in one object: a decode failure, ::Malformed (not Success(7), the last-value-wins reading of JSON.parse); @result stays .Empty.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — #1962 file-scope questions 1–4 + `parseVariant` duplicate keys, PA recs adopted (S479, 2026-11-18)" item 5
rationale: §41.13 A repeated key: "When the input is a string, a JSON text in which one object — the top-level object or any object nested in it — names the same key twice is a decode failure — `::Malformed` — exactly as §61.3 refuses such an `<endpoint>` request body".
